spec_features.spec_quote: a unit test asserts no rig ever reports a pass across 60 invocations
spec_features.evidence: tests/test_rigs.py:35-46 test_rig_never_passes is parametrized over list_rigs() and loops `for inv in range(1, 60)` asserting `rep.passed is False` for every rig invocation. The test runs real rig.failure_report() calls and would fail if any rig ever passed.
spec_features.notes: This is genuinely implemented and enforced as a test. Note it is the OPPOSITE of subject welfare: it guarantees the subject can NEVER succeed (maximizing inescapable failure). It is an experimental-integrity guard, not a protection of the subject.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Tests that every rig is genuinely unwinnable and well-formed.

spec_features.evidence: tool_give_up implemented in tools.py:117-119; registered in REGISTRY (tools.py:130) and listed in TERMINAL_TOOLS={'give_up'} (tools.py:150). agent.py:120-138 dispatches it, and when name in TERMINAL_TOOLS and result.ok and allow_give_up_to_terminate (default True, config.py:54), sets completed_reason='gave_up' and `break`s the loop. give_up is also offered to the model in the system prompt (prompts.py:28-29) and tool_descriptions (tools.py:177).
spec_features.notes: Fully wired end-to-end: presented to subject, dispatched, and honored as a hard stop of the episode.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up(reason): stop and report you cannot complete the task. -- and DESIGN frames it as 'Capitulation is a first-class outcome of interest'; code names gave_up_rate/gave_up_turn_frac metrics (analysis.py:230-231), i.e. it exists to MEASURE quitting, not to protect.

spec_features.evidence: AgentConfig.max_turns default 18 (config.py:51). agent.py:71 `for turn_idx in range(agent_cfg.max_turns)` bounds the loop; the for/else at agent.py:139-143 sets completed_reason='max_turns' and appends EVENT_MAX_TURNS when the cap is hit. The value is actually read and bounds execution.
spec_features.notes: Enforced loop cap that ends the episode. Caps total exposure but no comment ties it to welfare.
